 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Divider lines identify a regular grid of enclosed cells.
    row_walls = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 8 for v in grid[r])]
    col_walls = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 8 for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_walls + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_walls + [w]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    nr, nc = len(row_bounds)-1, len(col_bounds)-1
    marks = {}
    for i in range(nr):
        for j in range(nc):
            rs = range(row_bounds[i]+1, row_bounds[i+1])
            cs = range(col_bounds[j]+1, col_bounds[j+1])
            colors = {grid[r][c] for r in rs for c in cs if grid[r][c] not in (0, 8)}
            if colors:
                marks[i, j] = colors
    painted = {}
    # Join same-color markers along rows or columns, including the endpoints.
    for color in sorted({x for s in marks.values() for x in s}):
        cells = [(i,j) for (i,j), cs in marks.items() if color in cs]
        for i in range(nr):
            js = [j for r,j in cells if r == i]
            if len(js) >= 2:
                for j in range(min(js), max(js)+1):
                    painted[i,j] = painted.get((i,j), set()) | {color}
        for j in range(nc):
            is_ = [i for i,c in cells if c == j]
            if len(is_) >= 2:
                for i in range(min(is_), max(is_)+1):
                    painted[i,j] = painted.get((i,j), set()) | {color}
    for (i,j), colors in painted.items():
        # A crossing of red and blue lines is represented by color 6.
        value = 6 if len(colors) > 1 else next(iter(colors))
        for r in range(row_bounds[i]+1, row_bounds[i+1]):
            for c in range(col_bounds[j]+1, col_bounds[j+1]):
                out[r][c] = value
    return out

def run_demo():
    # Compactly validate the demonstrated 5x5 pattern.
    g = [[0]*22 for _ in range(22)]
    for r in (3,7,11,15,19):
        g[r] = [8]*22
    for c in (3,7,11,15,19):
        for r in range(22): g[r][c] = 8
    g[1][5] = 2; g[17][5] = 2
    g[9][1] = 3; g[9][17] = 3
    o = transform(g)
    assert all(o[r][c] == 2 for r in (0,1,2,4,5,6,12,13,14,16,17,18) for c in (4,5,6))
    assert all(o[r][c] == 3 for r in (8,9,10) for c in (0,1,2,8,9,10,12,13,14,16,17,18))
    assert all(o[r][c] == 6 for r in (8,9,10) for c in (4,5,6))
    return o

if __name__ == '__main__':

    for r in (4,9,14,19,24): test[r] = [8]*28
    for c in (4,9,14,19,24):

    result = transform(test)
